positive.reasoning: Criterion A1 (traumatic event): MET — patient described an event where they felt their life was in danger and someone else was seriously injured. Criterion B1 (re-experiencing): MET — patient reports having sudden images of the event and intense reactions to triggers. Criterion B2 (avoidance of thoughts): MET — patient tries to distract themselves from thoughts about the event. Criterion B3 (avoidance of reminders): MET — patient avoids places and situations that remind them of the trauma. Criterion C1 (inability to recall details): MET — patient experiences difficulty recalling specific details about the trauma. Criterion C2 (negative beliefs): NOT MET — patient reports feelings of hopelessness that come and go, not constant. Criterion C3 (blame): MET — patient feels at times that it was their fault for not preventing the event. Criterion C4 (negative emotions): NOT MET — feelings of fear and guilt are not constant. Criterion C5 (loss of interest): MET — patient avoids activities they used to enjoy. Criterion C6 (detachment): MET — patient feels detached from others and describes a barrier to connection. Criterion D1 (irritability): MET — patient reports increased irritability and anger outbursts. Criterion D2 (recklessness): MET — patient engages in risky behavior as an escape. Criterion D3 (hypervigilance): MET — patient feels tense and alert in triggering situations. Criterion D4 (startle response): MET — patient is more easily startled by loud noises. Criterion D5 (concentration): MET — patient struggles to concentrate due to intrusive thoughts. Criterion D6 (sleep disturbance): MET — patient has trouble sleeping due to thoughts about the trauma. Criterion E (duration): MET — symptoms began after the traumatic event and have lasted for more than one month. Criterion F (functional impairment): MET — symptoms cause significant distress and interfere with work and social interactions. Criterion G (exclusion): NOT MET — patient denies substance use or medical conditions that could explain symptoms. Total: 12 of 14 criteria met (threshold ≥ 5). Diagnosis: TRUE — full criteria met with significant functional impairment confirmed.
